data.one_liner: Access system resources like CPU load and memory usage via dart:ffi.
data.what_it_does: Provides easy access to system resources such as CPU load and memory usage. It calls operating system APIs directly using pure Dart with dart:ffi without needing any bundled native library.
use_when: You need to monitor CPU load average within your application.
You need to check physical memory usage across desktop or mobile platforms.
You want a pure Dart FFI implementation without external C binaries.
avoid_when: You are targeting the web platform, where it is not supported.
You require deep process-level profiling beyond basic global CPU and memory usage.
strengths: No bundled native library or C compiler required.
Supports multiple platforms including Linux, Android, macOS, iOS, and Windows.
Optional initialization and simple static API.
weaknesses: Not supported on the web platform.
Windows lacks load average support, instead measuring CPU usage since the last call or init.
